description: Terraform workspaces: a root whose configuration tells workspaces apart is evaluated once per workspace name found, besides default, and every result names its workspace.

review round 1: a root new in this change is evaluated in each workspace it tells apart, against nothing
review round 1: names the base already tells apart are evaluated first, so a change cannot push them past the cap
review round 2: a deleted root is checked in each workspace its base tells apart, so a root deployed only in prod is reviewed as deleted

reasonsContain: Root svc is deleted with 1 resource

reasonsContain: Root svc is deleted with 1 resource

base.terraform/environments/electronic-monito:
resource "aws_db_instance" "database_2022" {
  count          = local.is-production || local.is-development || local.is-preproduction ? 1 : 0
  identifier     = "database-v2022"
  engine         = "sqlserver-se"
  instance_class = local.application_data.accounts[local.environment].db_class
  username       = "admin"
}
